_comment: realtime_threshold_s es un parametro de DISENO (no medico): a partir de que demora de comunicacion (segundos, solo ida) la app prioriza actuar a bordo antes de esperar a tierra. No proviene de ninguna fuente medica. emergency_session_max_age_hours tambien es un parametro de DISENO (no medico): pasado ese tiempo, una sesion de emergencia guardada no se reanuda sola y se le pregunta a la persona si continua o reinicia.
tagline: Health guidance for when help is light-minutes away.

features._comment: Supported flags: charts (trend charts on the status board), reminders (due / no-frequency badges and the Due now block), emergency_guide (Emergency button, route and links), downlink_report (nav entry, links and route). Flags are bundled at build time.

disclaimer: Earth Is Far is a decision-support tool. It does not replace a flight surgeon or a physician. If in doubt, contact medical professionals.
